arStrings.szText: Each second while active, {c_important}Hurricane{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_14*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage.

Hurricane has {c_number}[SF_30]{/c} charges and can now be placed at the targeted location. Enemies hit are {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and have a {c_number}[SF_42*100|%|]{/c} chance to spawn {c_number}[SF_44]{/c} {c_important}{u}Dancing Bolts{/u}{/c} that deal {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_UPGRADEB_DANCINGBOLT}{/c} Lightning damage each.

{c_label}Recharge time: {/c}{c_resource}[SF_31]{/c} seconds

{c_important}Hurricane{/c} has no cooldown and deals {c_number}[SF_28*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage. {c_important}Hurricane{/c} costs {c_resource}[SF_29]{/c} Spirit per second while active. Cast {c_important}Hurricane{/c} again to toggle the effect off.

{c_important}Hurricane{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill.
Movement Speed is increased by {c_number}[SF_23*100|x%|]{/c} while {c_important}Hurricane{/c} is active.

{c_important}Hurricane's{/c} Critical Strike Chance is increased by {c_number}[SF_32*100|+%|]{/c} and an additional {c_number}[SF_34*100|%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance for each stack of  {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} active.
